title: R3.0F Capability Ledger
note: Defines each capability the R3.0F (final) phase of the Integrated Delivery Train may eventually enable, its kind, and the earliest checkpoint at which it may be unlocked. A capability being DEFINED here does NOT mean it is ENABLED. Enablement is governed by governance/r3.0f/state.json (enabledCapabilities). F0 only defines the universe; no production capability is enabled at F0. release_executed is the only capability tied to the actual semver bump + tag/release creation.

governance_bootstrap_present.description: R3.0F Integrated Delivery Governance scaffold present: schema, state, capabilities, checkpoint-manifest schema, and integration with the train-level validators.

migration_engine_present.description: Unified schema migration engine + per-store migrators (R2 export / R3 case / session / comparison [R3.0C] / experiment / outcome / hypothesis / follow-up). Old readable, future fail-closed, deterministic, no silent drop, backup + rollback. MUST NOT alter the frozen R3.0B case-record schema; migrators read/write via store APIs only.

e2e_automation_present.description: 8 E2E flow automation (new user / real telemetry / measured / reference lap / VRE / setup experiment / driver experiment / export-import) for browser + Electron. Zero console error; no stale UI.

quality_hardening_present.description: Quality bar: no console error / no unhandled rejection / no stale UI; keyboard nav; desktop responsive; large library; storage failure handled; no raw arrays in view model / Alpine reactive tree; busy states; destructive confirmations.

documentation_present.description: README / positioning / capability-map / r3-architecture / r3-user-workflow / r3-data-and-privacy / r3-credibility-model / r3-experiment-loop / CHANGELOG — all consistent with shipped surface. No 'professional validated' / 'AI replaced race engineer' claims.

release_gate_present.description: 12-condition release gate script (preflight, tests, E2E, frozen 0, preset 501, i18n parity, reachability, no orphans, Electron build OK, release notes drafted, CHANGELOG, tag policy). MUST run fail-closed.

release_executed.description: Final activation: package.json version 1.4.0 → 2.0.0 (single bump); the R3.0 Integrated Delivery Train Draft PR is merged; tag v2.0.0 and the corresponding GitHub Release are created AFTER merge + the new main CI PASS. release_executed=true on the post-merge state.json mirror records that this final activation completed; in the train branch itself this capability remains disabled until F6 checkpoint is staged.
